items.name: hero-01
items.title: Hero — Centered
items.description: Centered hero with badge, heading, description, and dual CTA buttons. Zero-JS Astro component.
items.author: SAASTRO <https://saastro.io>
items.docs: Astro component — zero JS, no React required. Default import: `import Hero01 from '@/components/blocks/hero-01.astro'` and render statically. Props: badge?, title, description, primaryCta {label, href}, secondaryCta?, class?.

items.name: hero-02
items.title: Hero — Split with Image

items.author: SAASTRO <https://saastro.io>
items.docs: Astro component — zero JS, no React required. Default import: `import Hero02 from '@/components/blocks/hero-02.astro'`. Props: badge?, title, description, primaryCta, secondaryCta?, imageSrc?, imageAlt?, class?.

items.title: Hero — Gradient

items.author: SAASTRO <https://saastro.io>
items.docs: Astro component — zero JS, no React required. Default import: `import Hero03 from '@/components/blocks/hero-03.astro'`. Props: badge?, title, description, cta {label, href}, class?.

items.name: features-01
items.title: Features — Icon Grid
items.description: 3-column feature grid with icons, titles, and descriptions in cards. Zero-JS Astro component.
items.author: SAASTRO <https://saastro.io>
items.docs: Astro component — zero JS, no React required. Default import: `import Features01 from '@/components/blocks/features-01.astro'`. Props: title?, description?, features [{icon: 'zap'|'shield'|'code'|'sparkles'|'globe'|'lock', title, description}], class?. Icons are built-in inline SVGs keyed by name — props stay serializable.

items.name: features-02
items.title: Features — Alternating
items.description: Alternating image and text sections to showcase features. Zero-JS Astro component.
items.author: SAASTRO <https://saastro.io>
items.docs: Astro component — zero JS, no React required. Default import: `import Features02 from '@/components/blocks/features-02.astro'`. Props: title?, description?, features [{badge?, title, description, imageSrc?, imageAlt?}], class?.

items.name: steps-01
items.title: Steps — Numbered How-It-Works
items.description: Numbered steps for a how-it-works section, with optional eyebrow and description. Zero-JS Astro component.
items.author: SAASTRO <https://saastro.io>
items.docs: Astro component — zero JS, no React required. Default import: `import Steps01 from '@/components/blocks/steps-01.astro'`. Props: steps[{title, description}], eyebrow?, title?, description?, class?. Los pasos se numeran solos por su orden: no metas el número en el texto. La cabecera entera es opcional — sin eyebrow/title/description el bloque pinta solo los pasos, que es lo que necesita un adaptador que quiera su cabecera editable.

items.name: pricing-01
items.title: Pricing — 3 Tiers
items.description: Three-tier pricing cards with monthly/annual toggle and feature lists.
items.author: SAASTRO <https://saastro.io>
items.docs: Import: `import { Pricing01 } from '@/components/blocks/pricing-01'`. Props: title?, description?, plans [{name, description, monthlyPrice, annualPrice, features[], popular?, cta {label, href}}], className?. Interactive (billing toggle) — in Astro hydrate with client:visible.

items.name: compare-01
items.title: Compare — Two-column table
items.description: Two-column comparison of paired statements, with column labels and check/cross marks. Zero-JS Astro component.
items.author: SAASTRO <https://saastro.io>
items.docs: Astro component — zero JS, no React required. Default import: `import Compare01 from '@/components/blocks/compare-01.astro'`. Props: labels{left,right}, rows[{left,right}], eyebrow?, title?, description?, class?. La columna derecha es la destacada por convenio; las dos se quedan lado a lado también en móvil, porque apilarlas rompe la comparación.

items.name: cta-01
items.title: CTA — Gradient Banner
items.description: Full-width CTA banner with gradient background, heading, and action buttons. Zero-JS Astro component.
items.author: SAASTRO <https://saastro.io>
items.docs: Astro component — zero JS, no React required. Default import: `import Cta01 from '@/components/blocks/cta-01.astro'`. Props: title, description, primaryCta, secondaryCta?, class?.

items.name: faq-01
items.title: FAQ — Accordion
items.description: FAQ section with accordion for expandable questions and answers.
items.author: SAASTRO <https://saastro.io>
items.docs: Import: `import { Faq01 } from '@/components/blocks/faq-01'`. Props: title?, description?, items [{question, answer}], className?. Interactive (accordion, Base UI) — in Astro hydrate with client:visible. Requires the base-nova (Base UI) accordion primitive.

items.name: faq-02
items.title: FAQ — sin JavaScript
items.description: FAQ con `<details>` nativo: cero JS, respuestas dentro del HTML servido e indexables. El hermano sin hidratar de faq-01.
items.author: SAASTRO <https://saastro.io>
items.docs: Import por defecto: `import Faq02 from '@/components/blocks/faq-02.astro'`. Props: title?, description?, items [{question, answer}], openFirst?, class?. Bloque Astro puro — NO lleva client:*, y no debe llevarlo: si lo hidratas pierdes lo único que lo distingue de faq-01. Elige faq-01 si necesitas animación de altura o un solo panel abierto a la vez.
